movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Civil: yue flute (left), feather plume (right). Military: shield (left), battleaxe (right).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Rows of dancers (64, 36, 16, or 4) based on rank.

music_profile.sound_description: Slow, stately, monophonic music featuring a wide range of traditional instruments including stone chimes, bronze bells, and various flutes and zithers.

basic_steps: Civil dance: Hold yue flute in left hand and feather plume in right.
Military dance: Hold shield in left hand and battleaxe in right.
teaching.formation: Rows of dancers (e.g., 8x8, 6x6, 4x4) determined by social rank.
teaching.rhythm: Monophonic with little rhythmic variety; 4 to 8 beats per phrase.
